## Summary

Describe the focused change and why it is needed.

## Validation

List the exact commands and manual checks that were actually run. Use `NOT RUN` for checks that were unavailable.

## UI evidence

For user-interface changes, include screenshots or recordings that contain no personal information.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change has a focused scope.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated where behavior changed.
- [ ] `dotnet format` was run or CI formatting is expected to validate the change.
- [ ] Relevant build/analyzer checks were run or are explicitly marked `NOT RUN`.
- [ ] Relevant tests were run or are explicitly marked `NOT RUN`.
- [ ] Documentation was updated where necessary.
- [ ] `what_changed.md` was updated for significant project work.
- [ ] `PROJECT_STATE.md` was updated when project state or next tasks changed.
- [ ] UI changes consider keyboard, screen reader, text scaling, contrast, and touch targets.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, signing keys, private tokens, or personal data are included.
- [ ] A changelog entry was added when the change is user-visible and release-relevant.
